findings.hypothesis: Most lesions share a uniform area bias
findings.evidence: Control Q1 predicted/GT area mean1.374,median1.036; Q4mean0.939,median0.998.
findings.conclusion: Tail cases strongly affect means; do not route or uniformly enlarge/shrink every case.

findings.hypothesis: A global threshold adjustment is sufficient
findings.evidence: Control validation threshold scan gain0.0156pp; C512aux gain0.0465pp in fixed0.2..0.8 scan.
findings.conclusion: This limited global scan does not explain the observed failure modes. No calibrated threshold adopted.

findings.evidence: Control50.34%ofFN are>8px insideGT under original distance; zero-padding convention still48.29%.73.82%ofFN have probability<0.1.
findings.conclusion: Substantial internal/confident errors; final predictions alone do not locate encoder vs decoder cause.

findings.hypothesis: Adding more global context is necessarily needed
findings.evidence: f4 zeroing strongly changes lightweight model; preserving its spatial mean causes much smaller damage. PPM zeroing changes A+0.0097pp,C-0.1512pp.
findings.conclusion: Current dependence is measurable but interventions are out of distribution; no causal proof of harmful fusion. Test retrained PPM removal first.

findings.hypothesis: Worst masks are caused by mismatched local files
findings.evidence: Four selected cases match official photos r>0.999 and exact Bicubic-resized official masks.
findings.conclusion: No pairing error found in these4. Two cases are documented noisy labels in prior literature; cannot extrapolate all data are correct or wrong.

findings.hypothesis: Noisy labels explain all unsuccessful modifications
findings.evidence: Only2 literature-documented examples established here; original complete-set metrics remain.
findings.conclusion: Unsupported. Do not exclude cases to manufacture improvement.

references.title: Skin Lesion Segmentation in Dermoscopic Images with Noisy Data
references.scope: Study uses ISIC2017; the verified same imageIDs are present in the official ISIC2018 Task1 training archive. Not a quality estimate of our whole dataset.

structural_caveat: PPM removal reduces parameters; not a capacity-matched pooling effect or claimed novel method.

proof.caveat: This source-order split is distinct from common randomized partitions; it is not evidence of leakage by itself. Keep historical results and current diagnostic run unchanged. Patient independence not established.
